categories.main_business_segments: Union Semiconductor (Hefei) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit (IC) advanced packaging and testing services sector, focusing on display driver chips. The company provides full-process packaging and testing services including gold bumping, wafer testing, chip-on-glass (COG), and chip-on-film (COF) packaging technologies. Its services cater mainly to LCD and AMOLED display driver chips, with expansion into automotive and image processing chip segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced packaging technologies such as gold bumping (Bumping), wafer testing (CP), glass chip-on-glass (COG), and thin-film chip-on-film (COF) packaging. It employs high-precision processes including micro-spacing bump manufacturing, wafer grinding and thinning, stable wafer dicing, and high-precision inner lead bonding. The firm is also developing next-generation packaging technologies like fan-out, 2.5D/3D packaging, and system-in-package (SiP) to overcome industry bottlenecks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading chip design companies primarily from Taiwan and mainland China, including Novatek, Tianyu Technology, and Himax Technologies. The end markets served include display panel manufacturers such as BOE and AU Optronics, focusing on consumer electronics like smartphones, tablets, digital cameras, TVs, and emerging automotive display applications. The company’s products are integral to LCD and OLED display driver chips used in these devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Hefei, Anhui Province, within the Hefei Comprehensive Bonded Zone. Its customer base and sales extend to overseas markets, particularly Taiwan, accounting for about 60% of revenue from foreign clients. The firm benefits from its location in the Yangtze River Delta, a major integrated circuit industry cluster in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Union Semiconductor operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing (OSAT). It does not engage in chip design or wafer fabrication but focuses on packaging and testing services for integrated circuits, particularly display driver chips.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding advanced packaging capabilities, increasing production capacity for AMOLED and Micro OLED display driver chips, and developing high-end packaging technologies such as fan-out, 2.5D/3D, and SiP. It emphasizes R&D investment to improve process yields, product reliability, and to broaden applications into automotive and image processing chips. Talent acquisition and retention, automation, and quality management are also strategic focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through customized packaging and testing service fees charged to integrated circuit design companies. The pricing model is based on material costs (notably gold for bumping) plus processing fees negotiated per customer order. The company operates on a direct sales model, delivering finished packaged chips to customers or designated panel manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the earliest in mainland China to achieve mass production of 12-inch wafer gold bumping for display driver chips and holds a leading position in advanced packaging technology for this segment. Major competitors include industry leaders like ASE Technology, Amkor, JCET, TFME, and Hua Tian Technology, with some competitors having broader product lines. Union Semiconductor focuses on display driver chips and is expanding into automotive and image sensor packaging to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.24 billion, a 31.78% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 196 million, up 10.59%. The firm has steadily increased its R&D spending and production capacity, with total assets reaching RMB 3.6 billion, reflecting a growth trajectory supported by IPO proceeds and internal investments. The company’s gross margin was 27.17%, slightly down due to cost increases and market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Union Semiconductor differentiates itself through its full-process packaging and testing capabilities for display driver chips, including proprietary micro-spacing gold bumping technology that enables high-density, reliable, and compact chip packaging. The company offers integrated services that reduce contamination risks and improve yield stability. Its strategic location within a major semiconductor cluster and strong relationships with leading chip designers and panel manufacturers further enhance its competitive advantage.
